Draft Advertisement Copy
Advertisement are invited for the position of Study Coordinator under the project of
Efficacy and safety of substitution of bleomycin by low dose nivolumab in ABVD
(Doxorubicin + Bleomycin + Vinblastine + Dacarbazine ) back none Chemotherapy
in newly diagnosed advanced stage pediatric Hodgkin Lymphoma: A phase II,
multicentric, open label, randomized control trial funded by National Cancer Grid ,
which is scheduled to be held on 21-Nov-2026 in the Department of Pediatrics.
Application Process: Interested candidates must Submit the application with resume
on plain Paper by 4:00 PM on 19 November 2026, with the subject line "Application
for Study Coordinator.” Shortlisted candidates will be notified by email regarding
the interview. At the time of the interview, shortlisted candidates must bring a
photocopy of their completed application paper, a detailed CV, a research statement
outlining their motivation for pursuing research, and self attested copies of their
degrees, mark sheets, experience certificates, and other relevant testimonials. These
documents must be submitted to the office of the Dr. Nishant Verma of the
Department, Department of Pediatrics , King George's Medical University (KGMU),
Lucknow.
Sr. No Post Qualification Salary
01 Study Coordinator Life Science Graduate 23,600
Appointment Term: The appointment of the selected candidate will be subject to the
terms and conditions set forth by the University or funding agency, specifically
applicable to this project, as required. The institute reserves the right to fill or not to
fill the post advertised.
No separate call letters will be issued for this interview. No T.A./D.A. will be paid
towards appearing in the interview.
Kindly acknowledge the receipt of the same.
